description: Public type-2 tower contact temperature override and duplicate wait suppression.

mutants.description: The public contact path must pass the incoming tool's interface temperature to set_extruder. WipeTower2 independently emits the contact pre-extrusion, so the enabled row's numeric incoming wait/temperature, restore and model-deposition oracles distinguish this append-layer gate from the disabled control.

With tower waiting disabled, the custom incoming-tool M109 remains and append_tcr2 must remove the duplicate untagged contact M109; exactly one interface wait per positive pre-extrusion catches this semantic regression.
